packets.name: Keep Alive
packets.description: The server will frequently send out a keep-alive, each containing a random ID. The client must respond with the same packet.

clientToServer.description: Sent by the client after the handshake to finish logging in. If the version is outdated or any field is invalid, the server will disconnect the client with a kick.

fields.name: Username
fields.notes: The name of the user attempting to login, max length of 16

serverToClient.description: Sent by the server if it accepts the client's login request. If it didn't, it'll send a kick instead.

fields.name: Map Seed
fields.notes: The server's map seed. Must be sent in respawn packets by the client.

fields.name: Dimension
fields.notes: -1: The Nether, 0: The Overworld, 1: The End

fields.name: Difficulty
fields.notes: 0 thru 3 for Peaceful, Easy, Normal, Hard

fields.name: Max players
fields.notes: Used by the client to draw the player list

clientToServer.description: This is the first packet sent when the client connects and is used for Authentication.

fields.name: Username
fields.notes: The username of the player attempting to connect, max length of 16

serverToClient.description: This is the server's response to the handshake packet, used for Authentication.

fields.name: Connection Hash
fields.notes: A unique, per-connection hash, or '-', or '+'

connectionHashValues.meaning: No Auth: The client continues without doing name authentication.
Password Auth: There is currently no way to send a password in at least version 1.0.0. It should be treated similarly to '-'.
Name Auth with minecraft.net: This hash is a randomly generated long in hexadecimal form.

packets.name: Chat Message
packets.description: A message from the client to the server, or the server to the client. The actual handling of chat messages is variable and depends on the server and client.

fields.name: Message
fields.notes: User input must be sanitized server-side

packets.name: Time Update
packets.description: Server to Client only. Time is based on ticks, where 20 ticks happen every second. There are 24000 ticks in a day, making Minecraft days exactly 20 minutes long.

fields.name: Time
fields.notes: The world (or region) time, in ticks. 0 is sunrise, 6000 is noon, 12000 is sunset, and 18000 is midnight.

packets.name: Entity Equipment
packets.description: After each 'Named Entity Spawn', there will be five of these packets for the equipped item and armor. If there are changes in visible equipment, another one of these is sent.

packets.name: Spawn Position
packets.description: Server to Client only. Sent by the server after login to specify the coordinates of the spawn point (the point at which players spawn at, and which the compass points to). It can be sent at any time to update the point compasses point at.

packets.name: Use Entity
packets.description: Client to Server only. This packet is sent from the client to the server when the client attacks or right-clicks another entity. A Notchian server only accepts this packet if the entity being attacked/used is visible without obstruction and within a 4-unit radius of the player's position.

fields.name: User
fields.notes: The entity of the player (ignored by the server)

fields.name: Target
fields.notes: The entity the player is interacting with

fields.name: Left-click?
fields.notes: true when the player is pointing at an entity and left-clicking, false when right-clicking

packets.name: Update Health
packets.description: Server to Client only. Sent by the server to update/set the health of the player. Added in protocol version 5. Food saturation acts as a food 'overcharge'. Food values will not decrease while the saturation is over zero.

packets.name: Respawn
packets.description: Sent to the client when they respawn after dying.

packets.name: Player
packets.description: Sent by the client when the player is on the ground or not.

fields.name: On Ground
fields.notes: true if player is on ground

packets.name: Player Position
packets.description: Client to Server only. Sent when the player moves horizontally.

fields.name: On Ground
fields.notes: true if player is on ground

packets.name: Player Look
packets.description: Client to Server only. Sent when the player rotates their head.

fields.name: Yaw
fields.notes: Rotation around Y axis in degrees

fields.name: Pitch
fields.notes: Rotation around X axis in degrees

fields.name: On Ground
fields.notes: true if player is on ground

clientToServer.description: Client to Server. Sent when the player moves and looks around.

fields.name: Yaw
fields.notes: Rotation around Y axis in degrees

fields.name: Pitch
fields.notes: Rotation around X axis in degrees

fields.name: On Ground
fields.notes: true if player is on ground

serverToClient.description: Server to Client. Sent to update the player's position and look.

fields.name: Yaw
fields.notes: Rotation around Y axis in degrees

fields.name: Pitch
fields.notes: Rotation around X axis in degrees

fields.name: On Ground
fields.notes: true if player is on ground

packets.name: Player Digging
packets.description: Client to Server only. Sent when the player digs a block.

fields.name: Status
fields.notes: 0: started digging, 1: cancelled digging, 2: finished digging

fields.name: Face
fields.notes: Which block face: 0: bottom, 1: top, 2: north, 3: south, 4: west, 5: east

packets.name: Player Block Placement
packets.description: Client to Server only. Sent when the player places a block or uses an item.

fields.name: Direction
fields.notes: Block face: 0: bottom, 1: top, 2: north, 3: south, 4: west, 5: east

packets.name: Holding Change
packets.description: Client to Server only. Sent when the player changes their held item.

packets.name: Use Bed
packets.description: Server to Client only. Sent when a player gets into bed.

fields.name: Entity ID
fields.notes: The entity ID of the player

packets.name: Animation
packets.description: Both directions. Sent when an entity animates (swinging arm, etc).

packets.name: Entity Action
packets.description: Client to Server only. Sent when an entity performs an action.

fields.name: Action
fields.notes: 0: start sneaking, 1: stop sneaking, 2: leave bed, 3: sprint start, 4: sprint stop

packets.name: Named Entity Spawn
packets.description: Server to Client only. Sent when a player spawns in the world.

fields.name: Rotation
fields.notes: Rotation in steps of 1/256 of a full turn

fields.name: Pitch
fields.notes: Pitch in steps of 1/256 of a full turn

fields.name: Collector Entity ID

packets.name: Add Object/Vehicle

packets.name: Mob Spawn

packets.name: Entity: Painting
packets.description: Server to Client only. Sent when a painting is added to the world.

packets.name: Experience Orb
packets.description: Server to Client only. Sent when an experience orb spawns.

packets.name: Stance update

fields.name: Velocity Y

fields.name: Velocity Z

packets.name: Attach Entity

packets.name: Entity Metadata
